offering_description.value: Owns and operates iconic live entertainment venues, including Madison Square Garden and Radio City Music Hall in New York, selling tickets to concerts, shows and sports events, plus food, beverage and nightlife through its hospitality business.

primary_services.value: venue rental; live event production; ticketing; hospitality and catering

customer_segment.value: B2C: concert, show and sports fans buying tickets, food and drinks; B2B: concert promoters, event producers, corporate sponsors and private event clients

end_markets.value: live entertainment; sports; hospitality and dining; corporate events

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: ticket sales and fees for events at its venues; product sales: food, beverages and merchandise sold at venues and restaurants; service fees: venue rental and event services paid by promoters and clients; advertising: sponsorships, signage and branded partnerships at venues
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs arenas and theaters that host events for promoters and fans; service provider: provides event production, hospitality and ticketing services to promoters and fans

geography_served.value: US national: New York, Los Angeles, Las Vegas and other US cities with hospitality and venue operations

specialization.value: related lines: live entertainment venues, restaurants and nightlife venues, event production and ticketing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: its arenas, theaters and restaurants where fans buy tickets and food; online: digital ticket sales and event information on its websites and apps; partners / resellers: third-party ticket resellers and promoters selling event tickets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: liquor licensing, public safety, building codes and data privacy rules for venues and hospitality

notes: Corporate structure and portfolio changed after the 2023 spin-off, so current business mix may differ from what is described.
